title: Missed items
summary: Missed items are planned items that did not air because the broadcast was interrupted. Each waits here until you reschedule or dismiss it.

entities.text: A track or program planned during an outage that did not reach the air, with its planned time, its clock, and the reason.
Puts the item into a later hour once, at its start, its end, or a fixed minute. The clock template does not change.
Marks the item as not to be aired again.

usage: Choose a target hour within the track plan and a placement. The hour is rebuilt around the item with the usual rules; if it does not fit or breaks a rule, the request is refused.
steps: Choose Reschedule, a target hour, and the placement.
Save and follow the operation in the header; or choose Dismiss.
mistakes: Choosing an hour that is on air or about to start. Such hours are frozen.
Placing a long program at a fixed minute where it does not fit before the next fixed element.

example.title: Rescheduling the news
example.text: The 14:00 news was missed. Reschedule it to 16:00 with placement Start. The 16:00 hour is rebuilt: the news plays first, and the music after it is fitted to the rest of the hour.

operations.edit: Rescheduling is a one-time change for the chosen hour only.
operations.delete: Dismissing cannot be undone, but the item stays in the played-tracks list as Not aired.

target_hour_start_utc.label: Target hour
target_hour_start_utc.text: A future hour within the track plan.

placement.label: Placement
placement.text: Start of the hour, end of the hour, or a fixed minute.

fixed_minute.label: Fixed minute
fixed_minute.text: Minute of the hour, 0 to 59, for a fixed placement.

fixed_tolerance_ms.label: Fixed tolerance
fixed_tolerance_ms.text: How far the start may move from the minute, in milliseconds. Default one minute.
